Blob bytes default to SQLite and can use a tenant-isolated filesystem bytes driver via FRICK_BLOB_DRIVER=filesystem plus FRICK_BLOB_STORAGE_PATH (FR-53 is done; see apps/server/src/storage/blob-bytes-driver.ts and docs/operations.md). Blob metadata remains in SQLite. Filesystem blob byte files are not yet included in NDJSON backup/restore or account export payloads, so operators must back up FRICK_BLOB_STORAGE_PATH separately until byte export lands.

Remaining scope:
- Object-storage / S3-compatible blob driver behind the same bytes-driver interface (FR-54).
- Blob byte backup/export integration for filesystem/object-storage drivers.
- Blob processing pipeline extensions for derivatives, MIME/size validation, moderation hooks, and richer lifecycle handling (FR-55).
- Orphaned-blob cleanup job (FR-57).

Per-user blob quota enforcement landed under FR-56. Keep this epic focused on external bytes storage and blob lifecycle; Postgres runtime-store work remains FR-4.
